q_thin_the_herd.name: Thin the Herd
q_thin_the_herd.summary: Boar have come down out of the greenwood and into the barley. Havenbrook wants them gone before the harvest is.

stages.desc: Hunt wild boar in the meadow

q_thin_the_herd.completion: The barley is safe for another season.

q_firewood.name: Cold Hearths
q_firewood.summary: The inn burned through its winter store early. Bring logs and nobody has to sleep cold.

stages.desc: Gather logs from the meadow trees

q_firewood.completion: The inn will be warm tonight.

q_ore_for_the_forge.name: Ore for the Forge
q_ore_for_the_forge.summary: The smith has orders she cannot fill and a cold forge to fill them with. Copper will do to start.

stages.desc: Mine copper ore from the foothills

q_orc_trouble.name: Trouble on the Road
q_orc_trouble.summary: Orcs have been working the Sunken Road, and the carters have stopped coming through. Make the road boring again.

stages.desc: Drive the orcs off the Sunken Road

q_orc_trouble.completion: The carters will risk the road again.

q_marens_letter.name: Maren's Letter
q_marens_letter.summary: Elder Maren has written to the guild and will not say what about. She only asks that it reach them today.

stages.desc: Take Maren's letter to the guild hall
Return to Elder Maren

q_marens_letter.completion: Maren reads your face more carefully than the reply.

q_the_sunken_road.name: The Sunken Road
q_the_sunken_road.summary: A surveyor went out to the Sunken Road with a satchel of paper and came back with none of it. Maren wants to know what he saw.

stages.desc: Search the Sunken Road for the surveyor's papers
Bring the page back to Elder Maren

q_the_sunken_road.completion: Maren folds the page twice and does not put it down.

q_emberfell_depths.name: The Emberfell Depths
q_emberfell_depths.summary: Whatever is gathering the orcs is doing it under Emberfell. Maren has stopped calling it a rumour.

stages.desc: Find the rusted key in the Emberfell mine
Descend into the lower workings
Put down the Orc Warchief
Carry the totem back to Elder Maren

q_emberfell_depths.completion: Maren turns the totem over once and puts it in the fire.

q_barrow_seal.name: What the Mire Keeps
q_barrow_seal.summary: A water-stained note left at the edge of the Mire. Someone went into the barrow on purpose, and wrote down why.

stages.desc: Enter the barrow beneath the Mire
Recover the barrow seal
Take the seal to the guild master

q_barrow_seal.completion: The guild master puts the seal in a drawer he then locks.

q_a_decent_meal.name: A Decent Meal
q_a_decent_meal.summary: The innkeeper can cook. What she cannot do is leave the inn long enough to find anything worth cooking.

stages.desc: Bring the innkeeper 5 cooked meat
Hand the food to the innkeeper

q_a_decent_meal.completion: She feeds you first, which is how you know it went well.

q_clear_the_trail.name: Clear the Trail
q_clear_the_trail.summary: Boar have come off the Whisperwood verges and onto the trail, and Bram's carts will not go past them. He wants the trail made dull again.

stages.desc: Hunt boar along the Whisperwood Trail

q_clear_the_trail.completion: Bram's first cart gets through without anyone running.

q_word_to_fernhollow.name: Word to Fernhollow
q_word_to_fernhollow.summary: Oona the herbalist has a remedy for Old Wendel's chest, and her knees will not take the north trail any more.

stages.desc: Take Oona's remedy to Old Wendel in Fernhollow
Return to Oona in Mossvale

q_word_to_fernhollow.completion: Oona asks how he looked, and listens to the answer.

q_mossvale_hides.name: Hides for the Tannery
q_mossvale_hides.summary: The tanner has shut up for the season with half the orders unfilled. Mossvale will pay for raw hides brought to the square.

stages.desc: Gather raw hides from the Whisperwood

q_mossvale_hides.completion: The hides go under a tarp by the tannery door until spring.

q_trail_wardens.name: Trail Wardens
q_trail_wardens.summary: Warden Sela is short of hands. Foxes are hunting the trail in packs, and something is teaching them to.

stages.desc: Drive the foxes off the Whisperwood Trail

q_trail_wardens.completion: Sela marks the trail safe on the gate board, in chalk.

q_old_offering.name: The Old Offering
q_old_offering.summary: Mira keeps the shrine at Fernhollow, and the pond has not had its offering since the hunters stopped coming north.

stages.desc: Bring Mira two boar haunches for the shrine

q_old_offering.completion: Mira lays the offering on the stone and does not say what she is listening for.

q_road_beneath_leaves.name: The Road Beneath the Leaves
q_road_beneath_leaves.summary: A weathered trail sign names two settlements beyond the eastern trees. Follow the old road to Mossvale, then take the north fork to Fernhollow.

stages.desc: Follow the eastern forest path into the Whisperwood
Follow the main trail east to Mossvale
Return to the trail fork and follow its north path to Fernhollow

q_road_beneath_leaves.completion: Smoke above the lodge, lamplight on the pond. The names on the sign are places you know now.

q_daily_boar.name: Barley Watch
q_daily_boar.summary: The boar keep coming back to the barley, and somebody has to keep sending them home.

stages.desc: Hunt boar in the Hollowmarch

q_daily_orcs.name: Road Patrol
q_daily_orcs.summary: The Sunken Road needs walking every day it is going to stay open.

stages.desc: Drive orcs off the Hollowmarch roads

q_daily_ore.name: The Forge's Order
q_daily_ore.summary: Halda posts an order for copper most mornings and takes whatever arrives by noon.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 8 copper ore

q_daily_ore.completion: Halda weighs it in her hand and nods.

q_daily_kitchen.name: Fish for the Inn
q_daily_kitchen.summary: Bess will cook anything with fins, and the pond and the lake are full of things with fins.

stages.desc: Bring Innkeeper Bess 5 raw minnows

q_daily_kitchen.completion: Fried minnows are on the chalk board by supper.

q_daily_logs.name: Kindling
q_daily_logs.summary: The inn's fires eat a stack of logs a day, and Bess would rather not split them herself.

stages.desc: Bring Innkeeper Bess 10 logs

q_daily_logs.completion: The woodpile by the kitchen door is tall again.

q_daily_foxes.name: Fox Patrol
q_daily_foxes.summary: Warden Sela wants the packs thinned every day until they stop coming back.

stages.desc: Drive foxes off the Whisperwood Trail

q_daily_foxes.completion: Sela chalks another quiet day on the gate board.

q_daily_hides.name: Tannery Stock
q_daily_hides.summary: The reeve buys hides for the tannery, a few at a time, whenever anyone brings them.

stages.desc: Bring Reeve Hadley 4 raw hides

q_daily_hides.completion: Hadley writes it in the ledger and pays out of his own purse.

q_daily_oak.name: Oak for the Lodge
q_daily_oak.summary: Pell has a buyer in Havenbrook who pays well for seasoned oak and asks no questions about it.

stages.desc: Bring Pell the Trader 5 oak logs

q_daily_oak.completion: Pell loads the oak and whistles.

q_daily_pike.name: Wendel's Supper
q_daily_pike.summary: Old Wendel will pay for pike, because in forty years he has never caught one himself.

stages.desc: Bring Old Wendel 3 raw pike

q_daily_pike.completion: Wendel says the pond is having him on. He eats well tonight.

q_the_water_remembers.name: The Water Remembers
q_the_water_remembers.summary: Mira says the lights on the pond come from somewhere you can only reach asleep, and that something there has been trying to speak.

stages.desc: Sleep after dusk, in a bed or at a camp, and dream
Find the voice in the dream
Wake, and tell Mira what the voice said

q_the_water_remembers.completion: Mira writes the words down, then burns what she wrote.

q_lights_on_the_pond.name: Lights on the Pond
q_lights_on_the_pond.summary: Hesper has watched the lights over the pond grow brighter every night. Something large is holding the dream together, and it is not friendly.

stages.desc: Put down the Nightmare Brute in the dreamworld
Bring Hesper 6 dream shards as proof

q_lights_on_the_pond.completion: Hesper hangs the shards over the door. The pond is dark tonight.

q_daily_nightmares.name: Nightmares Undone
q_daily_nightmares.summary: Only asleep. The slate in the dream asks for the same thing every night: fewer nightmares.

stages.desc: Defeat nightmares in the dreamworld

q_daily_nightmares.completion: The slate wipes itself clean when you look away.

q_daily_shrine_shards.name: Shards for the Shrine
q_daily_shrine_shards.summary: The slate asks for dream shards to be carried out of the dream and laid at Mira's shrine in Fernhollow.

stages.desc: Wake, and bring Mira 8 dream shards

q_daily_shrine_shards.completion: Mira sets the shards in the water, one at a time.

q_daily_brute.name: The Brute Returns
q_daily_brute.summary: Only asleep. The Nightmare Brute comes back every night. Someone has to put it down again.

stages.desc: Put down the Nightmare Brute

q_daily_brute.completion: For one night, the plateau is quiet.
